title: Matt Carney - Some Quite Fantastic Shapes: Procedural Narrative & Terry Riley’s In C
speaker: Matt Carney
talk_title: Some Quite Fantastic Shapes: Procedural Narrative & Terry Riley’s In C
description: Terry Riley’s landmark minimalist composition "In C" (1964) asks musicians to play through 53 melodic fragments in order using their own discretion around instrumentation and repetition. This unique approach balances procedural generation with authored intent in a way that can cause, in Riley’s own words, “some quite fantastic shapes to arise and disintegrate.” This talk will dive into Riley’s piece to look at how procedurally generated games with a strong sense of possibility (or “key”) utilize a balanced range of narrative tools and writing styles to make fantastic shapes of their own.
